payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each string, if length < 47, check all favorite strings for substring match using Python's find(); if found or length >= 47, output Good else Bad.
payload.rationale: The solution performantly brute-forces all substring checks without sophisticated data structures; among the given subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest complete search category as it exhaustively enumerates possibilities, though it lacks typical backtracking recursion.
